area.sourceLabel: METRO curb2curb pages and zone shapefile (agency-supplied)
area.bookingInfo: Book in the METRO On Demand app or call 713-739-7433, up to 7 days ahead.
area.tripRules: Trips can start and end anywhere in your zone.

notes: Zones from the shapefile METRO sent Atlas Outreach on 2026-11-13 (CIV-1452), METRO_curb2curb_zones_11132026.zip, in NAD83 Texas South Central (US feet), reprojected to WGS84. METRO says its public curb2curb maps are out of date; use only this file. One fix: Missouri City's outline passed through the same point twice at its start, a 167 sq ft loop; the two points making the loop were dropped so the zone passes the publish check (area otherwise unchanged). Hours from each zone's route page (all daily 5 a.m. to 7 p.m.); no holiday hours are stated, so none are shown. Open to anyone (regular fare for all; METROLift is the paratransit service).
